g.text: Real-time cyber-physical instrument rig, fail-safe audio DSP signal chain, and LangGraph deep agent coach
• Zero OS malloc / locks / file I/O
• RMS VU levels, CPU load, xrun counters
• Active loop mode, FX values, pedal status
• Proposes drill: loop bar & go dry
• Player MUST tap footswitch to confirm
• Watches takes/ folder for new takes
OmniRiff Architecture • Strictly reflects production code on main (audio/, engine/, vision/, firmware/, coach/) • HackPrinceton 2026
